text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: I couldn't show you the moment I got it...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
There is no need—to be ashamed of failure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"What matters is――improvement.
It's fine as long as you achieve your goal――someday."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
